name: Inline Files & Streaming Thinking
description: Forces assistant thinking blocks to render inline (full text) without requiring verbose mode or transcript mode. Neutralizes the `shouldShowFullThinking = isTranscriptMode || verbose` gate in the AssistantThinkingMessage component so the collapsed single-line '∴ Thinking' placeholder branch becomes unreachable and full thinking always streams inline. (Same-length subset of upstream patch-claude-display; the file-creation-as-diff and streaming-delta handler-injection sub-fixes are length-changing and out of scope for a same-length binary op.)

provenance.author: a-connoisseur
provenance.derived_by: anchored against pristine 2.1.158 using 2.1.88 source ref (components/messages/AssistantThinkingMessage.tsx)

operations.rationale: The AssistantThinkingMessage component gates inline rendering on `let w=isTranscriptMode||verbose`. Replacing the first OR operand identifier with the literal `1` makes `w` unconditionally truthy, so the collapsed-thinking early branch is never taken and full thinking renders inline regardless of verbose/transcript mode. Backreferences preserve the churned minified identifiers; `O||T`->`1||T` is byte-for-byte same length.
